question: The inscription in Sanskrit, recording the repairing of the Mauryan dam at Junagarh belonged to whom among the following ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudradaman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Junagarh inscription in Sanskrit belongs to **Rudradaman I**, a prominent ruler of the Western Satrap dynasty.
 
• It is one of the earliest known inscriptions in classical Sanskrit, dating back to the 2nd century CE.
 
• Rudradaman's inscription records the repair of the Sudarshana Lake (Mauryan dam) in Junagarh, Gujarat.
 
• This dam was originally constructed during the reign of Chandragupta Maurya and was later repaired by Rudradaman's engineers.
 
• The inscription highlights Rudradaman's patronage of engineering and Sanskrit literature, showcasing the cultural and administrative achievements of his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rudradaman I:** He was one of the most powerful rulers of the Western Satrap dynasty and is known for his significant contributions to art, culture, and administration.
 
• **Sudarshana Lake:** This lake, originally built during the Mauryan era, served as an important irrigation reservoir in ancient Gujarat.
 
• **Western Satraps:** A dynasty that ruled parts of western and central India between the 1st and 4th centuries CE, known for their cultural and architectural advancements.
 
• **Sanskrit Inscriptions:** Rudradaman's Junagarh inscription is considered a milestone in the history of Sanskrit epigraphy, marking the transition from Prakrit to Sanskrit as the language of royal inscriptions.
 
• **Engineering Achievements:** The repair of the Sudarshana Lake is an example of ancient Indian hydraulic engineering and underscores the emphasis on water management by rulers of the time.
